title: Two ticket props named: the guard's monitor and Kuro's label printer
caption: The machines the days 3 to 5 tickets are about now all exist as named things a scene can use: the gym's booking terminal, the common room's printer and the karaoke booth's song selector (in their own entries), and here the guard's monitor and a new label printer on the reception counter. None has a marker until a story uses it.

sections.title: Kuro's label printer
sections.caption: New: a squat grey label printer at the west end of the head office's reception counter, beside her screen, a strip of white label out of its slot.

sections.title: The guard's monitor
sections.caption: Unchanged to look at: the monitor on the guard's desk, its screen toward him. Its spot is beside it, so it stays in sight past Eric.
